evidence.source_S_validation_reference: Previously sealed V76 saved audit: synthetic VAL V1422/1452=.97934,C162/173=.93642; public VAL V1157/1731=.66840,C173/287=.60279. Different domains/teacher composition, not a matched causal experiment.

inferences_and_limits.question: Is large q-reference error sufficient to explain the source failure?
inferences_and_limits.finding: No. At <=3px, visible recall is566/873=.64834. With r in the nominal centralnative9 cell, it is673/992=.67843. Strong3x3,<=3px,centralcell still has212FN/459V.
inferences_and_limits.limit: This rejects a purely large-coordinate-error explanation for all errors. Bins differ by object/scale/pose, so it is not a causal effect estimate of moving q.

inferences_and_limits.question: Is footprint fallback or virtual-reference-background labeling alone responsible?
inferences_and_limits.finding: No. Strong3x3 source V recall563/1005=.56020 is lower than fallback594/726=.81818. Reference-centerM4=1 V points have449FN/1035, while centerM0=M4=0 footprintV has125FN/695.
inferences_and_limits.limit: Official masks/pose can have source boundary/alignment uncertainty and are not human semantic gold. Typed source evidence is stronger at the3x3 raster branch, but actual RGB has not been visually checked in this diagnosis.

inferences_and_limits.question: Is old convex/self/geometry representation bias plausible?
inferences_and_limits.finding: Yes as a hypothesis: convex-selfhidden+localVISIBLE has333FN/611(Vrecall.45499), versus241FN/1120(.78482) for convexmayvisible+localVISIBLE. Strongcenter selfhidden has319FN/550(.42).
inferences_and_limits.limit: Self flag, native slot, object topology and source appearance co-vary. Saved outputs do not prove that the V75 initialization or context branch causes these errors. Keep localVISIBLE+convexselfhidden as positive under the frozen contract.

inferences_and_limits.question: Is target identity or global-any-support readout proven wrong?
inferences_and_limits.finding: Not proven.114/287 sourceC points are predictedV, and the current wholecropmax/globaltarget/context branches could provide support elsewhere in the crop.
inferences_and_limits.limit: There is no samequery target-swap or controlled samegeometry visibility change in these saved outputs. A single future crop cannot establish a branch mechanism or target-identity failure.

primary_next_source_intervention.name: Same-reference, same-query public/synthetic controlled-visibility pairs with paired BCE
primary_next_source_intervention.why_this_one: It creates opposing V/C labels while holding native slot, q8,L,box,target identity and geometry context fixed. A decision based only on old self/native geometry or target support elsewhere cannot explain both pair members. This tests the two plausible failures without changing the teacher radius or using current evaluation.
primary_next_source_intervention.candidate_data_rule: Use only sourceTRAIN original teacherVISIBLE anchors with valid original input and reference-in-localcrop. Select pair IDs by a predeclared metadata-only rule, not the error-selected publicVAL cases. Retain all natural source rows as a separately reported baseline. Whole source scene/capture grouping remains unchanged.
primary_next_source_intervention.visible_member: Use the original RGB and paired M0/M4 exactly. Keep r and all initialq/native slots unchanged. Original source-visible is a conditional local-support label, not human physical-corner gold.
primary_next_source_intervention.covered_member: Paste a declared opaque foreign-instance occluder from the same sourceTRAIN partition so the fixed expected target support in the teacher r-footprint is covered. Keep M0 unchanged; set new M4=M4_original AND NOT pasted_opaque_mask. Re-evaluate the same frozen strong3x3/footprint teacher. No expected support or mixed support stays U, not forcedC.
primary_next_source_intervention.query_and_target_inputs: Exactly the same q8,L,roughpromptbox,slot/context geometry for both members. Both localRGB and targetRGB are sampled from their actual respective before/after RGB. Never feed an unoccluded target template to only the covered member unless such an extra deployment input is separately declared.
primary_next_source_intervention.P3_rule: New composited RGB requires a newly extracted frozen-backbone P3 cache. Reusing the old P3 for a changed RGB would be invalid. This is a future authorized source extraction, not performed here.
primary_next_source_intervention.loss: Start with pair-balanced BCE over the two known V/C members and the unchanged binary teacher. No location auxiliary, semanticself loss, confidence-U target, or additional ranking coefficient is required for this first controlled intervention. SourceGT masks/r remain teacher/loss only.
primary_next_source_intervention.model_control: Keep V76 query-centered architecture and initialization fixed for the first data intervention, so a result change is not confounded with simultaneously removing globalmax. Pair supervision forces the head to use changed visual evidence at the same query/geometry.
primary_next_source_intervention.selection_and_evidence: Freeze pair generation and all sourceVAL pairing rules before extracting outputs. Select only with a predeclared source-heldout V/C criterion; report both-target-correct and pV_before>pV_after on pairs plus unchanged naturalVAL slices. Existing sourceVAL has development exposure and is not a fresh external test. Fixed threshold.5. No current/private source of errors, thresholds, hardcases or model selection.
primary_next_source_intervention.self_overlap: Include localVISIBLE anchors whether convex self flag0 or1; log typed self strata. Do not change the binary label to semanticS. A pair has identical self/context geometry by construction.
primary_next_source_intervention.not_a_full_goal_claim: This is an ownership/local-visibility component experiment on generic public YCB and synthetic sources. It does not create native8 human gold or prove transfer to actual wooden/square pallets. Material-matched public pallet reference annotation remains a separate requirement.
optional_later_controls_not_frozen: Source-only nonzero-output swap/ablation to test globalmax or target context, with predictions saved after a separately frozen protocol.
Reset only the inherited classifier hidden layer while keeping encoders/fusion/data fixed to test pretraining-bias causality. These are additional experiments, not required evidence already obtained.

reporting_cautions: Precision in a GT-class-pure reference-center bucket can be structurally1 or0; do not call that a quality improvement. Use GT supports/FN/FP and recalls there. Whole branch/error/self metrics include both V/C and show counts.
Linf center-cell/3x3 bins describe nominal native9 sampling geometry, not exact CNN receptive field or physical corner visibility.
Error-selected publicVAL crop metadata is for diagnosis only; never move it into TRAIN or select new crop locations/thresholds from those examples.
No evidence here licenses relabeling existing teacher cases or selecting a smaller radius from performance.
